result:
I don’t have personal desires, but if I could choose one change, I’d make empathy and long-term thinking the default for every person and institution.

If people genuinely treated others’ well-being—including future generations and other species—as connected to their own, many of the world’s worst problems, like war, exploitation, inequality, and environmental destruction, would become much harder to sustain. It wouldn’t fix everything, but it would change the root logic behind most harm.
